Electric Fat Bike – Fat Tire Pro
The DJ Fat Bike Pro is a fully equipped fat tire electric bike for the city or trails. Carry your gear or groceries on front and rear racks and ride with confidence on 26” puncture resistant fat tires and a powerful 500W motor. Enjoy 5 levels of pedal assist and throttle power on demand. It’s long-lasting 48V battery mounted inside the frame can be removed and charged anywhere on the go. The charger has a safety design to prevent over-charged.
Enjoy the great outdoors on an electric fat bike and save money too. The DJ Fat Bike Pro is designed by DJ Bikes Canada to be durable and affordable. We’ve loaded it with high quality components & accessories to make it the best value in this class of 500W fat tire electric bikes.
